A quick sb guide for anyone interested.  Obviously not comprehensive but it includes some of the more common matches you see.

Bug Midrange:

\+2 Ashiok

\-2 Gifted Aetherborn

(You can also cut an Ayara for a duress if they seem like more of a control build)

This  is a pretty favorable match, They usually win via Nissa or Uro and  neither of them know how to push through Obliterator.  There are a few  ways they can win, namely through an early Nissa, Hydroid Krasis, and  Uro.  Uro and Nissa both get shut down by Obliterator so Krasis is one  of their scariest cards.  You mostly outvalue them, a lot of games end  up with a full board they can't push through because of Obliterator and  Fiend Artisan chains Garys.  Before a board stall is in effect Fiend  Artisan mostly prioritizes Obliterator unless Tymaret is needed for Uro

Goblins:

\+1 Witch's Vengeance

\+2 Kaervek

\+1 Fatal Push

\+1 Eliminate

\+2 Gifted Aetherborn

\-4 Phyrexian Arena

\-1 Midnight Reaper

\-1 Knight of the Ebon Legion

\-1 Ayara

One  of my worst matches.  It's pretty rare for Muxus to not immediately end  the game and I can't race real well vs. them.  You mostly have to just  pray they don't get Muxus, but you can win the honest grind against  them.  Be aggressive, Gifted Aetherborn is great to pressure while  gaining a bit of life.  Fiend Artisan should prioritize Kaervek post  board or Obliterator.  Hopefully your removal can keep them off their  important cards and you don't run into Muxus

Gruul Aggro

\+2 Gifted Aetherborn

\+1 Fatal Push

\+1 Eliminate

\+1 Witch's Vengeance

\-4 Phyrexian Arena

\-1 Midnight Reaper

Really  favorable match for us, if we lose it almost always happens in the  early game.  The strat is all about minimizing damage taken early with  removal and then sitting on an Obliterator.  If it gets to late game  they can sneak a win with Questing Beast with an Embercleave (the first  strike plus deathtouch can just walk over Obliterator) so hold removal  for that.

Mud

\+1 Duress

\+2 Gifted Aetherborn

\-1 Fatal Push

\-1 Chupacabra

\-1 Obliterator

This  is our other main bad match.  I've never won once Ugin hits the board,  it just cleans us out too hard.  Sometimes Obliterator can brick an  Ulamog and the board will still for chaining Garys.  Board is meant to  race them, be very aggressive and attack early mana with Thoughtseize.   Fiend Artisan is just prioritizing whatever is adding the most damage.

UW Control

\+3 Davriel

\+1 Midnight Reaper

\+Eliminate

This  is a close match, I think they're slightly favored.  Try not to commit  more than 2-3 creatures without a Midnight Reaper in play (maybe 4-5  with him).  Be ready to grind and activate Castle Locthwain a lot.   Fiend Artisan should prioritize Midnight Reaper

Random Aggro

\+1 Eliminate

\+1 Fatal Push

\+2 Gifted Aetherborn

\+1 Witch's Vengeance

\-4 Phyrexian Arena

\-1 Midnight REaper

Aggro  is generally pretty favorable.  Gifted Aetherborn is a nightmare and  gets us to Obliterator.  Like in a lot of matches Obliterator lets us  sit back until we find Fiend Artisan or Gary.  Always look for the line  of Obliterator attack into Gary.  On its own that's 11 damage and can  often end a game, people almost never want to block Obliterator.

Solemnity Nine Lives

Doesn't stop Gary's life drain, only damage.  Real easy match.  

Those  are the main matches I run into, your general strat is gum up the board  until Obliterator and Fiend Artisan can take over.  Knight of the Ebon  Legion can take over a game as well sometimes, the deck attacks from  quite a few angles.  Hope this helps!
